title: With Trim in hand, the trim bar stays clear of the captions and the notices
goal: A recording no longer opens with Trim in hand (that changed on 2026-09-25), so the bar no longer covers a caption on open. It can still come up over a captioned recording when someone picks Trim, and a caption or a notice under it would be half hidden. Check whether that still happens and fix it if it does.
notes: Reproduced 2026-09-23: Scripts/playtest.sh Scripts/playtest/captions-write-themselves-walk.json, picture 2-the-captions-wrote-themselves-sc.png (queue/audits/2026-09-23-captions-write-themselves-2-the-captions-wrote-themselves.png): the In 0:00 · Out 0:17 · Cancel · Trim capsule covers the middle of the caption line The transport bar and the timeline appear. The capsule comes from document.opensWithTrimInHand (EditorState.openRecordingAsDocument sets .trim). Options: lift the capsule above the caption band, or drop the fast-lane trim once the document has captions.
acceptance: With a captioned recording open and Trim in hand, the bottom caption is fully visible with the trim bar up, or the log says with a picture that it already was
A notice raised on the canvas (Clip added, a refusal) is readable end to end while the trim bar is up and a caption is on screen
A walk with no flags picks Trim on a captioned recording and photographs the three things apart
Works at Next defaults with no switch turned on, and an audit written under queue/audits/ gives the try steps and a real picture
